content.title: TikTok settles social media addiction lawsuit ahead of trial against Meta, YouTube
content.summary: TikTok agreed to settle a landmark lawsuit on social media ​addiction on Tuesday, according to one of the plaintiff's ‌lawyers, the same day the trial was due to start against two remaining companies.  TikTok is one of four companies, including Meta, Snap and YouTube, which is a unit of Alphabet-owned  Google, facing allegations that their platforms are fueling a youth mental health crisis.  The ⁠trial against Meta and ‌YouTube was scheduled to begin with jury selection on Tuesday in California Superior Court in Los Angeles.
